verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to call the Stripe API (docs-16, probe-4). An external AI client could therefore drive Issuing operations via natural language, and llms.txt plus markdown docs (probe-1, probe-2) support agent use. However, this depends on a third-party agent: there is no evidence of a first-party natural-language interface, and no evidence that the MCP tools cover Issuing-specific actions like creating cards or setting spending controls. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documented MCP coverage of Issuing endpoints, hands-on or independent corroboration.
